ICS 23.100.40; 75.120PGD 36Revised Standard from Last Update.1. SCOPEThis standard specifies the dimensions, material and other requirements for taper male stud elbow body made from forgings for use in oil-hydraulic systems.2. REFERENCESThe standards listed below contain provisions which, through reference in this text constitute provisions of this standard at the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid.
